detailInventory.description: Visible distance narrows the pink paths near the lit vanishing point.
The near left bank sweeps in from the lower edge and curls back around Benny.
The right bank turns outward beside the fourth gold coin.
Cyan water stays between the pink banks below Benny.
The two banks have independent edges and do not form a mirrored pair.
The near pink face widens markedly toward the lower crop.
Long painted white reflections follow the pink bend.
The glossy inner edge has a thin pale highlight.
Foam has broad low lobes and smaller peripheral bubbles.
Clusters have light pearl tops and cool lilac shade.
Rounded irregular foam sits outside the left bank before Benny.
The river and the splash remain open around the character.

criteria: Two curved bank footprints flank an open channel in the saved camera.
The oblique view shows two distinct paths with unequal bends.
A continuous low crown is visible on each bank from the oblique view.
The neighbouring foam has multiple low overlapping lobes and an open middle.
The near banks have hot pink faces with visible lighter streaks.
The small foam islands read as cool pale soap and remain distinct from the pink surface.
The saved-angle and oblique renders both retain visible pink streaks and foam detail.
Shading reveals the bank crown without turning the open channel opaque.
